journal_lines: Green bloom in the rock. Copper.
Blue-green tinge in the wall. Good sign.
Malachite in the stone. Copper vein behind it.
A vein of copper ran through the wall like a river drawn on a map nobody made.
Verdigris on the rock, the color of old bells nobody rings.
Copper warms in the paw. The stone keeps the heat for a long time after.
Blue-green dust on the fur. Looked like I had been swimming in something old.
Took the bright pieces. Left the dull. The dull will brighten in time.
Copper sings when the pickaxe finds it. A low note. A long one.
A nodule shaped like a small bird, almost. Took it anyway.
A streak of green leading into the dark. Followed it until it ran out.
